messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: gpu-pool-saturation detected in redwood-usw2-prod. autoscaling not responding. Paging current oncall.

sara: answering page. I'm seeing queue depth spike on inference GPU workers, lots of pods Pending reason=InsufficientGPU. dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/gpu-queues

mike: likewise. HPA for gpu-worker shows 0% target. prometheus-adapter errors in logs: `context deadline exceeded`.

eli: running quick checks: prometheus targets show gpu-exporter for several nodes down. lastScrape ~00:10, now 00:28. exporter process crashed after recent node agent roll (v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2).

sara: can we manually scale nodepool to relieve pressure? I will request +5 nodes on gpu-pool.

mike: initiating nodepool resize:
```
gcloud container clusters resize redwood-usw2-prod \
  --node-pool=gpu-pool --num-nodes=16 --region=us-west2
```

infra-ci-bot: Nodepool resize requested. status: IN_PROGRESS. console: https://console.cloud.google.com/k8s

eli: doing targeted fix: restarting gpu-exporter daemonset on nodes with crash. command:
```
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/gpu-exporter -n infra
```

kate: I'll start evicting batch jobs (label=batch=true) to free GPUs for low-latency routes. draining 3 nodes now.

mike: hold non-critical deploys. also toggled routing: route tier=free -> small-model-fallback in us-east-1 to reduce pressure in us-west-2.

sara: prod HPA: `kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-worker-hpa` shows TARGETS 0%/80% still. adapter not returning external/custom metrics.

eli: prometheus now scraping exporters again on most nodes. adapter logs show successful queries after exporter restart.

mike: restarting prometheus-adapter to clear errors.

sara: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter -n monitoring` executed.

(2m)

mike: adapter back healthy. external metrics API returning values for `gpu_queue_length`. HPA target updated to 65%.

sara: HPA reacted: scaling from 2 -> 8 replicas. queue length trending down from ~700 -> ~220.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged. severity P1 due to elevated latency for realtime inference in us-west-2.

eli: customer impact: we saw elevated tail latency for ~15 minutes starting 00:18. Preliminary: 4 customers experienced timeouts (C-2381, C-9922, C-4043, C-8721). Support notified, SRE to coordinate postmortem.

luis: taking handoff in 10. Sara, drop a short bullet list with current state and open actions.

sara: short summary:
- root cause: gpu-exporter crashed after node agent rollout -> Prometheus scrape gaps -> prometheus-adapter timed out -> HPA had no metrics and didn't scale.
- mitigations performed: manual nodepool scale (+5), drained batch jobs, restarted exporter, restarted prometheus-adapter, temporary routing fallback and rate-limits on free tier.
- current state: HPA resumed, replicas increasing to handle backlog, queue dropping to ~180 and decreasing.
- open actions: pause agent rollout to GPU nodes, create rollback for agent version on nodes that crashed, add liveness/startup probes to exporter, add alternate metric (node GPU utilization) to HPA as fallback, notify affected customers.

luis: acknowledged. I'll monitor for 2 hours, ensure agent rollout is blocked, own the postmortem, and coordinate customer comms with support/product.

kate: adding note: consider circuit-breaker for prometheus-adapter timeouts so HPA falls back to a conservative scale rather than 0%.

eli: filing follow-up issue: stronger exporter probes + pin stable agent version for gpu nodes. will include logs and exporter stacktrace.

incident-bot: INCIDENT redwood-usw2-gpu-autoscale-lag 1: mitigated -> status: monitoring. duration 00:18:10 -> 00:36:00. incident page: /incidents/1820000001

sara: thanks team. closing shift handoff. :white_check_mark:
